name: 405 Caribbean Dr Unit Main
description: Charming townhouse in the sought-after "Island Club West" community. Upon entering the ground floor, you find a staircase to the left and, straight ahead, an open-concept kitchen, dining area, and living room with sliding doors leading to the patio; there is also an additional bedroom with a bathroom on this level. The second floor features two bedrooms: the master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom and a closet, and there is another bedroom that also has a private bathroom.
